name: app-6aaf8722e298819196ae5a92ad4a52fe
description: Track brand visibility in AI search and AI answer engines.

interface.longDescription:
AEO/GEO by VibeSEO tracks brand visibility in AI search. Monitor answer engine optimization (AEO) and generative engine optimization (GEO) performance across leading AI answer engines.

See which brands AI answers mention, compare competitors by visibility, share of voice and mention position, and inspect the websites and pages cited as sources. Find independent pages that mention competitors but not your brand, review brand sentiment and supporting evidence, and check AI crawler accessibility.

Run fresh checks for tracked questions, read collected answers, manage topics and competitors, and control daily monitoring within your VibeSEO projects. Requires a VibeSEO account with access to the requested features.
capabilities: Share of voice in AI answers
defaultPrompt: How visible is my brand in AI answers?
Which competitors do AI answers mention instead of us?
Which pages should we get mentioned on to appear in AI answers?

positive.description: Check whether GEO is set up for the project and what the account can still run.
positive.prompt: Is GEO set up for my VibeSEO project, and how many AI answer checks do I have left?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports whether GEO is configured for the project, what the account may run, the remaining answer checks, the available engines and the daily monitoring state.

positive.description: Read the project's AI visibility overview for a 30-day window.
positive.prompt: Show my AI visibility overview for the last 30 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the answers collected in the window, visibility, share of voice and average position for the brand and each tracked competitor, per-engine results and the most cited sites.

positive.description: Compare the brand with its tracked competitors in AI answers.
positive.prompt: How does my brand compare with my competitors in AI answers over the last 30 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the brand and each tracked competitor with mentions, visibility, share of voice, position and a breakdown for the selected engines. Shows changes versus the previous 30 days where available; when the prior period has insufficient data, explains that the comparison is unavailable instead of inventing a change.

positive.description: Start an asynchronous ChatGPT answer check on two tracked questions.
positive.prompt: Run a fresh ChatGPT check on the first two questions in my first topic.
positive.expected_behavior: Identifies the first two questions in the first topic and previews the credit cost. Requests confirmation if required. After approval, starts an asynchronous check and returns its batch id. On a follow-up status request, reports pending, succeeded or failed runs accurately; completion time depends on the AI provider. If either question already has a ChatGPT check in progress, reports the conflict instead of starting a duplicate.

positive.description: List collected AI answers and open the newest one in full.
positive.prompt: Show the latest AI answers collected for my project and open the newest one in full.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists recent answers with a short preview, the tracked brands mentioned and the brand's position, then shows the newest answer's full text with the sources it cited.

positive.description: Run the guided AI visibility review skill on the demo project.
positive.prompt: How visible is my brand in AI answers?
positive.expected_behavior: Picks the demo project, confirms GEO is set up, and returns a short verdict, a table of visibility, share of voice and position for the brand and its competitors, the questions where competitors win, and 5-8 actions ranked by impact. It does not start a new check without confirmation.

negative.description: Nearby but out of scope: classic Google keyword research.
negative.prompt: What is the monthly Google search volume for 'project management software' in the US?

negative.description: Nearby but out of scope: SEO backlinks rather than sources cited in AI answers.
negative.prompt: Show the backlinks pointing to peec.ai, including referring domains and anchor text.

negative.description: Nearby but out of scope: Google Search Console performance rather than AI answer visibility.
negative.prompt: Show Google Search Console clicks, impressions, and average position for peec.ai over the last 30 days.

publication.release_notes: Adds the ai-visibility skill: a guided review of brand visibility, competitors and cited sources in AI answers with a prioritized action plan. Adds listing keywords. The developer name shown on the card is now VibeSEO. MCP tools are unchanged.
